description: Defines the SearchParameters class used for handling search criteria in the Fineract core infrastructure, including fields for filtering and methods for checking presence of criteria.

classes.name: SearchParameters
classes.description: A class encapsulating various search criteria for querying entities within the Fineract system, with methods to check the presence of specific filters and handle default values.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit for search results, defaulting to 200 if not set, or null for unlimited if set to 0 or negative.

methods.name: getOrphansOnly
methods.description: Returns true if the orphansOnly filter is set to true.

methods.name: getIsSelfUser
methods.description: Returns true if the isSelfUser filter is set to true.

methods.name: hasOrderBy
methods.description: Checks if the orderBy field is non-blank.

methods.name: hasSortOrder
methods.description: Checks if the sortOrder field is non-blank.

methods.name: hasOfficeId
methods.description: Checks if officeId is set and non-zero.

methods.name: hasLimit
methods.description: Checks if limit is set and greater than zero.

methods.name: hasStaffId
methods.description: Checks if staffId is set and non-zero.

methods.name: hasLoanId
methods.description: Checks if loanId is set and non-zero.

methods.name: hasSavingsId
methods.description: Checks if savingsId is set and non-zero.

methods.name: hasProvisioningEntryId
methods.description: Checks if provisioningEntryId is set and non-zero.

methods.name: hasProductId
methods.description: Checks if productId is set and non-zero.

methods.name: hasCategoryId
methods.description: Checks if categoryId is set and non-zero.

methods.name: isPerson
methods.description: Returns true if legalForm indicates a person (value 1).

methods.name: isEntity
methods.description: Returns true if legalForm indicates an entity (value 2).
